title: Premier looks to issue NT$10,000 cash handout by Lunar New Year
summary: Taipei, Oct. 8 (CNA) The government plans to start issuing a proposed NT$10,000 (US$313) cash handout in January, before the Lunar New Year holiday, if the 2027 general budget clears legislative review by Jan. 5, Premier Cho Jung-tai (卓榮泰) said Thursday.

title: Taiwan cooperation key to Indo-Pacific stability: Ex-President Tsai
summary: San Francisco, Oct. 7 (CNA) Former Taiwan President Tsai Ing-wen (蔡英文) said Wednesday that deeper international cooperation with Taiwan will not only strengthen its security, but also boost stability in the Indo-Pacific and the resilience of other democracies.

KMT lawmaker to propose tougher penalties for drug-impaired driving
summary: Taipei, Oct. 7 (CNA) A lawmaker from the main opposition Kuomintang (KMT) on Wednesday said he plans to introduce legislation to impose tougher penalties for driving under the influence of narcotics, including the possibility of the death penalty for repeat offenders who cause a fatality.

title: 18-month jail sentence sought over surveillance of DPP's Shen
summary: Taipei, Oct. 7 (CNA) Prosecutors on Wednesday sought an 18-month prison term for a man accused of taking NT$360,000 (US$11,299) from two Hong Kong residents to surveil Democratic Progressive Party (DPP) Legislator Puma Shen (沈伯洋) in 2024.

title: Three U.S. House members visit Taiwan, to meet President Lai
summary: Taipei, Oct. 7 (CNA) A United States congressional delegation is in Taiwan for a four-day visit, during which it will meet with President Lai Ching-te (賴清德) and other senior officials, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MOFA) said Tuesday.

Foreign minister opens Phoenix office, 14th U.S. diplomatic post
summary: Taipei, Oct. 6 (CNA) Foreign Minister Lin Chia-lung (林佳龍) joined Arizona Governor Katie Hobbs and Phoenix Mayor Kate Gallego to open Taiwan's 14th representative office in the United States, in Phoenix, Arizona, on Monday (local time).
